dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetrical narrowing starting from the mid-section and progressing steadily towards the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median tone across the primary dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, parallel longitudinal linear marks (rake marks) concentrated on the lower-mid dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent group of vertical/longitudinal parallel scars (rake marks) on the posterior half of the visible dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast, dark circular aperture on the anterior portion of the dorsal surface.
